author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This I know to be true.
context_before: Paul tells us that Christ is in you, although your body is dead.
context_after: I have stopped time and witnessed how dead this body is. Time and again I have moved into a society, arrested the activity in me that causes the animation I am observing, and everyone has stood still. They appear to be as dead as the statues of clay or marble in a museum. I have entered a room to become possessed by the motion that inspires things. I have arrested this action, and everything has stood still. I have walked among those present to discover they are all dead. Now I know that Paul’s statement is true: “If Christ is in you, although the body is dead, he who raised Christ from the dead will raise you also, through his Spirit within you.”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This I know to be true.
context_before: The prophets equate the Rock with the Lord God Jehovah.
context_after: One day I sat in the silence, when quartz appeared before my vision. As I watched, the rock fragmented into numberless pieces and instantly molded itself into the human form, seated in the lotus posture in profound meditation. As I realized I was looking at myself, the form began to glow. It increased in intensity until it reached the limit of translucency. Then it exploded and my vision came to its end. Now I know I am the Rock that begot me.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: God and his name are one!
context_before: Scripture is all about God, as there is no one else.
context_after: That name is I AM! Falling asleep, God breathed upon your body and it became animated, as He dreams your world into being. One day God will awaken and all of your confusion will end. Then you will take off your garment of death to return to the being you were before that the world was. You will be enhanced beyond your wildest dreams, for there is no limit to your expansion and translucency. A limit was set to contraction and opacity, which is the body of death called Man; but your expansion and translucency is limitless.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Everyone is this completely diffused being.
context_before: I saw myself begotten out of a rock, for the rock fragmented, then gathered itself together to form a person I knew to be myself – not the being I shave in the morning, but myself raised to the nth degree of perfection. That being was meditating me, and I must become as perfect as He is. And when I am He awakes and I am eternal life, the one who came down into a body that was dead, to dream the dream of life.
context_after: Knowing that you are, you are mentally saying I am; and that is God’s name forever and ever.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Paul’s passages about marriage are not.
context_before: Now, not everything in the Bible is inspired.
context_after: Paul confesses he is not married and wishes that everyone were as he is; but if that were true there would be no offsprings. Paul did say: “It is far better to marry than to burn.” In other words, it is better to have union with what he calls the marriage state, than to long for such satisfaction. This was his opinion, not his inspiration. In his letter to the Romans, Paul states his opinion about the homosexual – only because he forgot that in the Old Testament God made everything and pronounced it good and very good. If God made everything, then God made the homosexual, did he not? So not every word of scripture is inspired; but you will know the passages that are, for when you awake, scripture unfolds in you.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This is the mystery of inspiration.
context_before: Having experienced scripture, when I disappear from this world I cannot go without, for – containing all within myself – I must go within.
context_after: You will be possessed by a vision, to find yourself playing the central role in a drama that is taking place within yourself. And when the vision fades you will search the scriptures to find the inspired word of God you have just fulfilled.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: That is the Christ who fulfills scripture.
context_before: It is the Christ within man who is his hope of glory.
context_after: Having had scripture fulfill itself in me, I have interpreted to you in all the scriptures the things concerning – not a man called Neville, but God’s power, in me, called Christ.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Mystery Of Inspiration (1969-01-01).
